question: What percentage of tests will be positive for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in HHS Region 9 (the Southwest and Pacific) for the week ending September 19, 2026, in CDC data?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the percent of tests positive for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in HHS Region 9 (the Southwest and Pacific) for the week ending 2026-09-19 in CDC's the National Respiratory and Enteric Virus Surveillance System (NREVSS) percent positivity data (data.cdc.gov dataset rgnm-fkqb), as posted on 2026-10-30.
research:
I've pulled the CDC data and am writing up the summary now. All values below come from the current version of the dataset. I left out every week after 2026-08-15, because that is about the latest week CDC would have posted by 2026-08-24.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the RSV "percent_pos" value for "Region 9" for the week ending 2026-09-19 in data.cdc.gov dataset rgnm-fkqb, as posted on 2026-10-30. Each week's test counts there are about 2,800 to 4,500. [dataset](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)
- 2026-08-15: the latest Region 9 RSV value available by 2026-08-24 was 0.45%, from 3,086 tests. The week before (ending 08-08) was 0.76%, and the week ending 08-01 was 0.76%. [dataset](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)
- These numbers can change slightly between postings, so the 2026-10-30 posting is what counts.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The target week ends 2026-09-19, about four weeks after today.
- RSV in Region 9 is at its summer low point, under 1%. 2026 summer values in the dataset:
  - 06-20: 2.24%
  - 06-27: 1.25%
  - 07-04: 1.00%
  - 07-11: 1.55%
  - 07-18: 0.85%
  - 07-25: 0.51%
  - 08-01: 0.76%
  - 08-08: 0.76%
  - 08-15: 0.45%
- The 2025-26 season ran late. Positivity was still 4.28% on 04-04 and 2.07% on 05-09, and stayed around 1.6% through mid-June. [dataset](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-08-06: British Columbia (Canada, nearby but not part of Region 9) reported low RSV activity. [BCCDC](https://www.bccdc.ca/Health-Info-Site/Documents/Respiratory_data/respiratory_surveillance_2026-08-06.pdf)
- 2026-03-24 and earlier: California's health department (CDPH) said the 2025-26 RSV season started later than earlier seasons and was still elevated in March. [CDPH](https://www.cdph.ca.gov/Programs/OPA/Pages/CAHAN/CDPH-Recommends-Immunizing-Infants-with-RSV-Monoclonal-Antibodies-through-April-2026.aspx), [Cal epi brief](https://v4v6.github.io/Cal_epi_newsletter/editions/2026-03-24.html)
- I found no California-specific RSV news from August 2026. CDPH's dashboard is updated most Fridays. [CDPH](https://www.cdph.ca.gov/Programs/CID/DCDC/Pages/RespiratoryVirusReport.aspx)

## 4. Base rates (Region 9, same dataset)
How the value moved from about the week ending 08-15/08-24 to the week ending about 09-19/09-21 in past years:

| Year | Mid/late Aug | Sep 19-21 week | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 | 08-16: 0.57%, 08-23: 0.39% | 09-20: 0.77% | +0.2 to +0.4 points |
| 2024 | 08-17: 0.38%, 08-24: 0.49% | 09-21: 0.83% (09-14: 0.99%) | +0.3 to +0.45 points |
| 2023 | 08-19: 1.16%, 08-26: 1.35% | 09-16: 2.69%, 09-23: 2.75% | roughly doubled |
| 2022 | 08-20: 1.79% | 09-17: 4.25% | +2.5 points (early season, after COVID) |
| 2021 | 08-21: 9.23% | 09-18: 12.53% | unusual summer surge after COVID |
| 2019 | 08-17: 0.67%, 08-24: 1.19% | 09-21: 1.26% | about +0.1 to +0.6 points |
| 2020 | 0.0 to 0.3% | 09-19: 0.00% | pandemic, almost no RSV |

- Pattern: in every year except 2020, positivity rose from mid-August to mid-September. In typical recent years (2024, 2025) it went from about 0.4-0.5% to about 0.8%. In 2023 it rose from about 1.2% to about 2.7%.
- Week-to-week noise at these low levels is about ±0.2 to 0.3 points, for example 2024's 0.49, 0.15, 0.33, 0.99, 0.83. [dataset](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)
- Compared with past years: 2026's early-August values (0.76%) are above 2024 and 2025 at the same point (about 0.33-0.57%) and well below 2022 and 2023. The latest week (0.45%) is in line with 2024 and 2025. Test volumes are similar to 2024-25.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets on this, and no published expert forecast for Region 9 RSV positivity. CDC publishes RSV hospitalization forecasts, but I found none covering this specific test-positivity measure.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Four more weekly CDC NREVSS releases (weeks ending 08-22 through 09-19) are due before the target week's data first appears, around late September. The value used for resolution is the one posted on 2026-10-30, after any revisions.
- Schools reopening in August and September usually come before the autumn rise in RSV. Region 9 seasons usually start between October and December, but 2022 and 2023 started earlier.
- Infant RSV antibody shots (nirsevimab, clesrovimab) and adult vaccine campaigns usually start in late September or October. They are unlikely to affect the 09-19 week.
- I did not find a weather outlook that matters here. This series is driven by the season, not short-term weather.
